capabilities: Publish notes as a public website
extras: The plugin requires running a separate self-hosted SimpleSync server. It does not use telemetry or third-party services.
problem: Users require a private, self-hosted solution to synchronize their Obsidian vaults across multiple devices without relying on third-party cloud services.
summary: Self-hosted synchronization solution for Obsidian vaults, allowing users to manage notes, web edit, and publish content via a private server.
